name: WelshWise geography quiz historical question and answer archive
subject: geography
evidence: Official Geographical Association page lists 2022–2025 question sets, answer sheets and answers; 2015–2020 older sets available only by request; no event in 2021.

name: WorldWise Local Quiz sample round archives
subject: geography
evidence: Official Geographical Association page links sample rounds 2023–24, 2024–25 and 2025–26; full ZIP resources require organizer registration and were not accessed.

name: French IESO national selection and international geoscience papers
subject: earth_science
evidence: Official Sciences à l’École page indexes national selection questions and corrected versions 2011–2026 (not all years visible), plus international IESO written/practical rounds with language variants.

name: French-language IPhO theory and experiment papers and solutions
subject: physics
evidence: Official French delegation page indexes theoretical and experimental IPhO papers 2005–2025 with linked corrigés and language variants; 2024 explicitly lacks French translations.

name: International Young Naturalists Tournament historical problem and scoring index
subject: interdisciplinary_research
evidence: Official IYNT problem-level index includes historical 2013 onward problem identifiers and juror/science-fight statistics, not a guarantee of downloadable solutions.

name: International Young Naturalists Tournament participant solutions and scoring provenance
subject: interdisciplinary_research
evidence: Official IYNT overview links team-defended solutions, scores and edition pages; reuse permissions for participant presentations unknown.

subject: data_science_research
